articles.title: MoneyGram launches Visa stablecoin card as remittance rivals expand
articles.snippet: MoneyGram is following rival Western Union’s lead, rolling out a Visa stablecoin debit card as it expands blockchain-based payments.

articles.title: AI Agents Spending Money Online? New Research Says Not Really
articles.snippet: TRM examined roughly $52.7 million across 198.9 million settlements using the x402 protocol. Most of it isn’t coming from AI agents, it says.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rises as Markets Digest Inflation Data Ahead of Fed Rate Decision
articles.snippet: Inflation held at 3.4% and core cooled annually, but a hot monthly core reading kept Fed hike odds near 62% while crypto markets rallied broadly.

articles.title: Bitcoin at $400K by 2030 Still 'Reasonable Target': Coinbase CEO
articles.snippet: Brian Armstrong argues the bottom is in, a year into the downturn, with the next halving roughly 18 months out.

articles.title: Nasdaq Invests $100M in Kraken Parent Payward at $21B Valuation
articles.snippet: Deutsche Börse's April stake implied a $13.3 billion valuation. Five months on, Nasdaq is paying at $21 billion.
